filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Thu Oct 15 – Fri Oct 16 PT

market_briefing.lede: The analyst scorecard for revenue-action platforms just reset around the same two watchlist names, while Salesforce's outbound agent gets a named data spine. Gong and Outreach both landed as Leaders in Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Revenue Action Orchestration; Demandbase announced it is a flagship data partner for Salesforce Hunter (still in pilot).

bullets.text: Dual Leaders: Gong (Oct 16) says it is one of four Leaders among 13 vendors and claims the highest Ability to Execute and furthest Completeness of Vision positions; Outreach (Oct 15) is a Leader for the second consecutive year and says Critical Capabilities ranked it 1st for Acquire New Customers and 2nd for Retain and Grow Accounts.

Hunter data partner: Demandbase named flagship data partner for Salesforce's Hunter outbound sales agent (Oct 15), building on Demandbase MCP on AgentExchange; Hunter remains in pilot with GA planned later in 2026. Partner PR, not a Salesforce newsroom GA.

Conversation context into assistants: Airspeed launched an MCP server into Claude and ChatGPT directories (Oct 15) — calls, deal intelligence, playbooks, and CRM/task actions via 61 tools. Continues the CI-to-assistant MCP pattern.

biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 15: partner announcement wires Demandbase account intelligence (and MCP on AgentExchange) into Hunter; Hunter still in pilot with GA later in 2026.

biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 15: conversation + deal context and governed CRM/task actions for revenue teams inside the assistants (61 tools); Claude connector directory and ChatGPT plugin directory.

watch.title: Salesforce's October GAs: Agent Optimizer and AI Skills
watch.body: Mid-to-late October and still no public GA flag or pricing for Agent Optimizer (beta through account executives since Sep 21) or AI Skills in Agentforce Coworker (pilot), both promised for October '26; Hunter stays in pilot (Demandbase partnership does not change that). interpretation.fact: Gong (Oct 16) and Outreach (Oct 15) were both named Leaders in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Revenue Action Orchestration. Demandbase announced it is a flagship data partner for Salesforce Hunter (Oct 15; Hunter still pilot). Airspeed launched an MCP server into Claude and ChatGPT (Oct 15). interpretation.note: Light interpretation: the same Gartner RAO report giving Gong and Outreach dual Leader badges, plus Demandbase wiring account intelligence into Hunter, says the near-term competitive frame is who owns seller action and who feeds the outbound agent — while Salesforce's October agent-ops GAs are still pending.
